title: NoraCopilot hardcodes Copilot Studio webchat URL with environment GUID
detail: Line 10: `var WEBCHAT_URL = 'https://copilotstudio.microsoft.com/environments/6ee0cd74-e2b2-e429-ac4b-27123cd20d19/bots/cua_agent_iRkq7/webchat?__version__=2';` â€” the environment GUID `6ee0cd74-...` is baked into the SPA bundle, so Test and Prod render the SAME Nora bot. If a different Copilot Studio env is used per stage, every deploy has to rebuild the bundle. Violates the loadConfig mandate in CLAUDE.md.
recommendedFix: Move the webchat URL to dcfg_configs as `dcfg_nora_webchat_url`. Read via `getEnvVar('dcfg_nora_webchat_url')` with the current value as fallback. Allows per-env override without a SPA build.
